integrity.method: Explicit idempotent derivation, a symbolic obstruction invariant, and exhaustive finite BFS with replayed word witnesses.

scientific_limitations.not_claimed: No classification for other fields, quadratic forms, dimensions, or arbitrary parenthesizations.
scientific_limitations.scope: Only the four-dimensional spin factor over \(\mathbb F_3\) with \(q(x,y,z)=x^2+y^2+z^2\).

title: A finite-field obstruction and exact word-length census for a simple spin factor over \(\mathbb F_3\)
